trap.label: provável + to
trap.why: Em português, "é provável chover" leva o aluno a usar probable + to. Em inglês, probable não aceita to; use likely to.

mcq.why: likely to; probable não aceita to.

opts: It is probable that it will rain.

fix.wrong: It is probable to be cold tonight.
fix.right: It is likely to be cold tonight.
He is likely to arrive early.
They are likely to arrive late.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com likely: “Maybe it will rain.” (use It)
Reescreva com unlikely: “She probably won't come.”
Passe para pergunta: “He is likely to win.”
